caption: The drawing depicts two views of the same long-sleeved garment on a plain, light tan background. The main focus is a front view of a loose-fitting shirt with wide, gathered sleeves that taper into narrow cuffs fastened by small buttons. The shirt has a pointed collar and a tie at the front neckline. The hem of the shirt is rounded and the sides are slit slightly upward. To the right and slightly above the main shirt, there is a faint outline of the same shirt viewed from the back, showing the back collar and an arm bent at the elbow, with additional detail at the cuff. The lines are clean and simple, rendered in black or dark grey, with no color shading except for the tan tone of the paper. The drawing occupies the center of the page, while the rest of the space remains blank.
title: Shirt
